advisories.title: Infinite Loop in org.apache.thrift:libthrift
advisories.description: org.apache.thrift:libthrift versions before and including 0.12.0 are vulnerable to Loop With Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop'). A server or client may run into an endless loop when fed with specific input data. This bug only affects certain language bindings; any languages not listed here were either patched in an earlier release or were never affected: `as, cpp, c_gsrc, d, dart, go, javame, js, lua, nodejs, ocaml, py, rb, swift`.

cweIds: CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
